title: Sharp Order Laws and Finite-Defect Stability for Domination versus Small Laplacian Eigenvalues in Trees
summary: For a tree T, let gamma(T) be its domination number and let mu(T) count the Laplacian eigenvalues in [0,1). The strict inequality gamma(T)/mu(T) =2, max_{|V(T)|=n} (7 gamma(T)-9 mu(T)) = floor((n-20)/9). Thus order twenty-nine is the first at which the ratio 9/7 can be exceeded. The proof is based on an exact decomposition of Phi(T)=|V(T)|-20-9(7 gamma(T)-9 mu(T)) into nonnegative integer terms, together with a clean-contraction identity.
